note: Exploratory. Similarity is the correlation of monthly anomalies over one period; it does not show cause and effect, and two series that both have a long-term trend look similar for that reason alone.

input.database: analysis.series_embeddings (pg load, pg clean, pg derive)

methods.vector: monthly anomaly (calendar-month mean of the whole series removed, gaps filled by the mining gap policy) over the window, standardised to mean 0 and standard deviation 1; the cosine similarity of two vectors equals the Pearson correlation of the two anomaly series. No trend is removed
methods.candidates: only the series shown on the website (the same list as the queries); a different variable, not in the same quantity group; any location
methods.significance: t test of the similarity as a correlation with an effective sample size corrected for the lag-1 autocorrelation of both series; Benjamini-Hochberg over all candidate pairs, not only the listed ones
methods.detrended: both series have their own least-squares line removed and are standardised again before the similarity is computed; trend_sensitive marks pairs whose two similarities differ by more than trend_sensitive_delta or have opposite signs
